Asha: Quick follow-up from today — RCA posted for INC-2026-045: https://redwood.example/rca/INC-2026-045. Highlights + action items in the doc. Please add owners inline.

Elliot: Noted. Question: are we keeping the temporary routing rule in place until telemetry shows <0.1% fallback for 24h?

Asha: Yes that's the plan. We'll require 24h with fallback <0.1% and P95 latency within baseline. If not met, rollback to previous routing.

Nora: I'll take ownership of the telemetry validation (dashboard and alert). Will pair with Observability to implement the queries.

Marta: I'll extract a 2-min clip of the decision comment and drop it here: https://redwood.example/clips/1782201082-decision.mp4

Samir: I'll update the runbook to include the new routing rule and rollback steps. PR soon.

oncall-bot: Incident bot: INC-2026-045 moved to "postmortem" by Asha.

Elliot: Also requesting a short blurb for Dedicated customers explaining the temporary routing and SLA impact. @Nora can you draft?

Nora: Yep — drafting now; will post to #customer-success for review by EOD.

Asha: Action items recap: 1) Telemetry dashboard - Nora; 2) Runbook update - Samir; 3) Clip + comms - Marta; 4) Dedicated FAQ - Nora/Elliot. Add yourself in the RCA if different. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
